IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
ANTICIPATORY BAIL APPLICATION NO.1643 OF 2025
Aman Hamid Khan  …Applicant
Versus
The State of Maharashtra & Anr. …Respondents
Mr. Ganesh Gupta a/w. Mr. Sahil Ghorpade, Mr. Rahul Lolandkar, 
Mr. Surya P . Gupta, Mr. Madan Khansole and Ms. Priyanka Rathod 
i/b. GG Legal Associates, for the Applicant.
Mr. C. D. Mali, APP , for the Respondent No.1-State.
Ms. Ashwini Acharii a/w. Mr. Taraq Sayed and Mr. Anish Pereira, 
for the Respondent No.2-Complainant
Mr.Pankaj Khopade, PSI, attached to Kondhwa Police Station, Pune 
City , Pune, present.
CORAM: MADHAV J. JAMDAR, J.
DATED  : 16th OCTOBER 2025
PC:-
1. Heard  Mr.  Gupta,  learned  Counsel  appearing  for  the 
Applicant, Mr. Mali, learned APP appearing for the Respondent 
No.1-State  and  Ms.  Acharii,  learned  Counsel  appearing  for  the 
Respondent No.2-Complainant.
2. This application is filed under Section 482 of the Bharatiya 
Nagarik  Suraksha  Sanhita,  2023,  seeking  pre-arrest  bail  in 
connection with C.R. No.123 of 2025 registered with Kondhwa 
Page 1  
Sonali

929-ABA-1643-2025.DOC
Police Station, Pune, for the offence punishable under Sections 75, 
78, 351(2) and 356(2) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023.
3. As per the prosecution case the First Informant is knowing 
the Applicant as they are residing in same locality. They were i n 
relationship till September 2024. But the First Informant refused to 
marry  applicant  as  he  is  not  earning  anything  and  addicted. 
Therefore, applicant started threatening informant and defaming 
her.  He  has  defamed  informant  and  her  family  members  by 
publishing objectionable messages on social media. He has shared 
some  messages  to  relatives  of  informant  on  31.01.2025.  He  is 
causing  harassment  to  informant  by  demanding  sexual  favours 
from her under the threat of defamation.  
4. Mr.  Gupta,  learned  Counsel  appearing  for  the  Applicant 
tenders affidavit of the Applicant dated 29 th September 2025. In 
the said affidavit it is stated that the Applicant will reside at  Life 
Style  Taylor,  Near  Sheher  Police  Station,  Azaad  Nagar  Manjal 
Gaon,  Dist.  Beed,  Maharashtra  4311314.  Mr.  Gupta,  learned 
Counsel submits that the Applicant is young person and he will co-
operate with the investigation and will not repeat the said conduct. 
Page 2  
Sonali

929-ABA-1643-2025.DOC
He submits that the Applicant will remove all the photos o f the 
Applicant with the victim posted on any social media and herein 
after he will not contact the victim in any manner whatsoever and 
will not post any message, photo etc. concerning the victim on the 
social media.
5. Mr. Mali, learned APP appearing for the Respondent No.1-
State  and  Ms.  Acharii,  learned  Counsel  appearing  for  the 
Respondent  No.2  strongly  opposed  the  Anticipatory  Bail 
Application. 
6. However, the Applicant is a young person. He has filed the 
affidavit as set out herein above. 
7. Accordingly , the case is made out for grant of Anticipatory 
Bail. In view thereof, the following order is passed:
O R D E R
(a) In the event of arrest of the Applicant-Aman Hamid 
Khan  in  connection  with  C.R.  No.123  of  2025 
registered with the Kondhwa Police Station, Pune, the 
Applicant  is  directed  to  be released  on  bail on his 
Page 3  
Sonali

929-ABA-1643-2025.DOC
furnishing P .R. Bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with 
one or two solvent
 sureties in the like amount.
(b) The  Applicant  shall  attend  the  Kondhwa  Police 
Station,  Pune,  on  29 th October  2025,  30 th October 
2025 and 31 st October 2025 between 11:00 a.m. to 
02:00 p.m.  Thereafter, the Applicant shall attend the 
Kondhwa Police Station, Pune, as and when called and 
shall cooperate with the investigation. Thereafter, the 
Applicant shall not enter the Pune District, except for 
attending the trial and except between 21 st November 
2025 to 2 nd December 2025 to attend the marriage of 
the sister of the Applicant.
(c) The  Applicant  shall  stay  at  Life  Style  Taylor,  Near 
Sheher Police Station, Azaad Nagar Manjal Gaon, Dist. 
Beed,  Maharashtra  4311314  and  report  to  Sheher 
Police Station, Azaad Nagar, Manjal Gaon, Dist. Beed, 
Maharashtra 4311314 on 1 st and 3 rd Sunday of every 
month till conclusion of the trial. The Senior Police 
Inspector  of  the  said  Police  Station  to  inform  the 
Investigating Officer about the same.
Page 4  
Sonali

929-ABA-1643-2025.DOC
(d) The  Applicant  shall  delete  the  photographs  and 
messages relating to the victim posted on social media 
within  a  period  of  3  days  from  today ,  if not  done 
earlier.  The  Applicant  shall  not  post  any  post, 
message,  photographs,  videos  on  social  media 
concerning the victim hereinafter.
(e) The Applicant shall furnish his cell phone number and 
residential  address  to  the  Investigating  Officer  and 
shall keep the same updated, in case of any change 
thereto.
(f) The Applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any 
inducement,  threat,  or  promise  to  any  person 
acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade 
such a person from disclosing the facts to the Court or 
to any Police personnel. 
(g) The Applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution 
evidence  and  shall  not  contact  or  influence  the 
Complainant  or  any  witness  in  any  manner 
whatsoever.
(h) The  Applicant  shall  not  leave  India  without  prior 
Page 5  
Sonali

929-ABA-1643-2025.DOC
permission of the Court.
8. It  is  made  very  clear  that,  in  view  of  the  allegations 
contained in the FIR, if any of the conditions are violated by th e 
Applicant, then the Anticipatory Bail granted to the Applicant is  
liable to be cancelled.
9. The Anticipatory Bail Application is disposed of accordingly .
[MADHAV J. JAMDAR, J.]
